sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Culture Awareness comprises identifying all values, interests, behavior patterns and the general orientation of an organization and especially its employees. It assesses the 'as is' culture — the current cultural preferences of the organization — and compares it with the defined desired culture. Inter-cultural aspects in set-up, communication and project approach are also considered.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Improves alignment of change initiatives with organizational culture. Enhances employee engagement and acceptance. Reduces cultural resistance to transformation. Supports sustainable change through cultural integration. Enables targeted communication and training strategies.
